summary: FD_TC_101_No Determination | Data Missing | 14 Days | APPR
title: No Determination | Data Missing | 14 Days | APPR
description:
DDS cannot complete eligibility assessment because critical flight data is MISSING from back-end systems (Trip Tracer, FDM). The actual arrival time has not been finalized � without it, DDS cannot calculate delay, identify MSL, or determine the tier. The system has already waited the full 14-day retry window for data ingestion, but the data never arrived. Since DDS cannot make a determination either way (Eligible or Not Eligible), the result is No Determination (ND) and the case is routed to a human agent for manual investigation using alternative data sources. Different from NE (where DDS definitively says "not eligible") � ND means "we don't have enough data to decide."

Prerequisites:
PNR: single passenger (Adult). Journey: 1 leg AC operated, Flight AC 377, YUL?YYZ. Flight date: April 25, 2026. Trip Tracer data status: INCOMPLETE � actual arrival time NOT finalized; flight status not confirmed in FDM. Scheduled arrival: Available. Actual arrival: MISSING (not ingested into Trip Tracer). 14-day retry window: EXHAUSTED (flight was April 25, claim filed after May 9 � data still not available). Disruption code: Cannot be assessed (dependent on missing data). Regime: APPR (domestic).
